note: Scoring is now syllable-level again. pinyin-pro is bundled with esbuild into a single ESM file (457KB / 150KB gzipped) so the Pages Worker can load it, restoring separate initial / final / tone scoring (weights: tone 0.5, final 0.3, initial 0.2). Key gotcha: pinyin-pro calls setTimeout at module top level, which Cloudflare Workers forbid in global scope - so it must be loaded with dynamic import() inside the fetch handler, not a static import.
